purpose: Teach: キロメートル/秒間/車掌/電柱/ノース/サウス/サッシ/リール

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 物流ルートの総距離をキロメートル単位で集計しましょう
lines.en: Let's aggregate the total distance of our logistics routes in kilometers.
lines.style: Brisk, purposeful opening. Clipped delivery without harshness. Speaking to a peer, not down. Business-steady pace, crisp articulation on the request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバの応答を秒間単位で監視します
lines.en: Yes—I'll monitor the server response times in real-time.
lines.style: Quick affirmation with a small pause before the commitment. Warm cooperation. Steady, competent tone. No hesitation, just an easy readiness to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員旅行で車掌アナウンスを録音させてもらいましょう
lines.en: On the company trip, let's ask if we can record the train conductor's announcements.
lines.style: Lighter tone than before. A hint of quiet delight in the specificity of the request. Still professional, but this task has a small personal spark to it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倒れた電柱の地域に支援物資を送ります
lines.en: Yes—I'll send relief supplies to the area where the power pole fell.
lines.style: Steady, grounded tone. No drama, just actionable resolve. The kind of response that says this matters and will be handled. Warm undercurrent of understanding.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 北米のノースカロライナ支社と連携しましょう
lines.en: Let's coordinate with the North Carolina branch in North America.
lines.style: Clear directional tone. Geographic specificity delivered without stumbling. Same purposeful pace as line one. Expectation that this will happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。南東部、つまりサウスイースト地域に営業所を開きます
lines.en: Yes—we'll open a branch office in the Southeast region.
lines.style: Confirmation with quiet confidence. Slightly slower on the geographic detail to show care with accuracy. Warm agreement. Forward-looking without being rushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内サッシの結露対策を急ぎましょう
lines.en: Let's move quickly on condensation prevention for the office windows.
lines.style: Directional and action-oriented. Light urgency without panic. Sharp on the word 'quickly' but not aggressive. Practical and matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告動画のリール編集を進めます
lines.en: Yes—I'll get started on the reel editing for the promotional video.
lines.style: Final affirmation with closure. Warm and capable. Slightly faster pace, showing momentum. The smallest hint of genuine readiness, not just duty.
